descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S19 「手机宽度上的 dashboard（Pixel 7 Chromium、iPhone 15 WebKit）」 Dashboards on phone width (Pixel 7 Chromium, iPhone 15 WebKit)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T2 The Nursing Home dashboard reuses the Hospital dashboard design (SOW Exhibit B)（TFA-92598 AC 2；TFA-92598 How it works 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given Visual lane profiles pixel7 and iphone15

When Open both dashboards

Then The four tiles sit in one row without truncated labels or numbers. Rows are not covered by the bottom bar. No horizontal overflow. Rows are tap targets of at least 24 px

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：visual-lane findings covered/overflow/truncated/tap = 0 on the dashboard screens; findings go to a human (vision-review.sh)

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-20.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S19

Dashboards on phone width (Pixel 7 Chromium, iPhone 15 WebKit)

Tickets: TFA-92598 Rounding Dashboard (in progress)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: yes）：lists.spec.ts (phones only): eight rows per dashboard; tiles in one row, overflow/truncated, each row scrolled into view uncovered, rows >= 24 px. [2026-10-14 review] 'covered' and 'tap' added to the scoped layout check: the oracle names covered / overflow / truncated / tap.

Detail:

iphone15, pixel7: 28 judged check(s) passed, 0 failed.

只记录的格子（recorded）：vision-review (for a person): 'In Progress' wraps onto two lines so its number sits lower than the other three tiles.

证据：附了 5 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/TC-20_S19 — 目录（10 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
